text.en: Customer feedback about store staff presents a marked contrast. Many regular shoppers praise team members like Tiff for being exceptionally knowledgeable, cheery, and helpful with pet dietary advice. However, multiple critical reviews describe uncomfortable surveillance by employees, perceived bias, and dismissive responses when issues were raised.

Reviewers value the store's wide selection of pet food brands, reptile supplies, and natural treat markets. Several customers appreciate the convenience of ordering specialized items. In contrast, negative reviews criticize uncomfortable summer store temperatures and report finding insect pests in unpackaged dog treat display bins.

Shoppers report very positive responses from their dogs and cats regarding treats and food purchased at the branch. Pet owners note that tailored dietary recommendations from staff helped them select long-lasting chews that their animals thoroughly enjoyed. Customers frequently return to restock favoured pet supplies.

q.en: Does the Maypole store stock natural pet treats and chews?

a.en: Yes, customers highlight an extensive treat market with a wide variety of natural chews and snacks for dogs.

q.en: Can staff help order specialized reptile supplies?

a.en: Reviewers note that employees assist reptile owners with specialized equipment and can order items into the store.

q.en: Are staff available to advise on pet diet and treats?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention asking knowledgeable staff members for guidance when choosing treats for different breeds.
